Puesto abierto

Graduate software engineer

A first engineering role for a recent graduate: join the software team of an automotive supplier in Turin and learn to build vehicle test tools.

  1. Inicio
  2. Empleo
  3. Graduate software engineer

Our client supplies test benches to car makers. Its software team builds the tools that run and analyse the tests.

Responsibilities

  • Develop features of the test tools in Python and C#, with a mentor
  • Write automated tests
  • Take part in reviews and planning with the team

Requirements

  • A degree in computer science or computer engineering, completed in the last year or due soon
  • Some programming experience, from university projects or an internship
  • Good command of English

Nice to have

  • Interest in vehicles and testing
  • Basic Italian

What we offer

  • A permanent contract from the start
  • A mentor for your first year
  • Hybrid work after the first three months
